title: Batch 6 - homebrew editor, homebrew pages and imports

states.ids: A28, A40, A10, D5, A27, first-screen rule
states.what: Items tab with 9 items, in the catalog's head pattern (plan review R3). 1180: the title, the four tabs with counts, «Новый предмет» and «Ещё» (import, pin) on one row; the search row (search, count, «Выбрать») beside the filter column (f74eae09). 360: the title is the tab picker «Предметы ▾» with «Новый предмет» beside it; one row holds the search, «Фильтры» and «Ещё» («Выбрать», import, pin). Rows have no checkbox column. No «Справка» (owner, 2026-10-29).
Open at 360: the tab picker as a sheet with the four tabs and their counts. At 1180 the tabs are a row, so the page is as in homebrew-items.
Open: «Ещё»: at 1180 «Импорт из файла» and the pin («Стартовый раздел», a check when on); at 360 «Выбрать» first, as the catalog.

A source picked (mock 3's filter-active state): the chip lit in gold, «Фильтры · 1» lit, «Показано 5 из 9» in the first group head at 360 and in the search row at 1180, no pill row; «Сбросить» and «Ссылка на фильтры» in the column head; the group heads drop the source name.
Open: the filter sheet at 360, «Ссылка на фильтры» in its head and «Сбросить» with «Показать 5» in its foot; at 1180 the column is always open, shown with keyboard focus on the picked chip.

Open: the selection mode, 2 ticked: the bar sticky at the bottom of the list with «Переместить (2)» open (source, section, the move button and the one-line consequence), «Скачать JSON (2)», «Удалить (2)» and «Снять выделение» last; «Выбрать» is hidden.
Empty: a new author. The empty-state pattern names what an own item does (the fact the help panel held) and one next step.
Error: the read failed. The cause and «Повторить»; no tabs and no import while nothing is read, as today.
Sources tab: limits in words, two controls per row («Разделы», «Ещё»), the source «Ещё» menu open; «Хоумбрю» says what goes there.
Open: «Разделы» of one source: its sections with counts, rename and delete, a new-section field, the 30 limit.
Sets tab: the set row shows its bonus and members, so a set needs no definition; the shared card limit is named.
Empty: the Sets tab says what a set is in its empty state - one of the facts the removed help panel held.
Rule cards tab: the rule text on the row and how many items refer to it.

Open: «Ещё» > «Импорт из файла» opens the panel under the head: one line on what files fit and a «Формат файла» link, one summary, a target per source, «Если уже есть:» with its consequence, one primary.

states.ids: A6, A8, A12, D15, A11 (artefact), first-screen rule
states.what: The editor: the back link and the title share one row (a breadcrumb), the title on one line at 360 (the Name field holds it in full), no «Хоумбрю» badge (every item here is the author's own); short choices two to a row, optional fields marked, full words, no field «?» (owner, 2026-10-29); the preview beside the form (360: «Предпросмотр» in the fixed bar opens a sheet), «В списках: 1» as a link, «Связи · 3» folded. «Урон» labels its two inputs, «Кость урона» and «Бонус к урону» (rule 15b).
Open: «Связи» with no «?»: «Вне линии / Ступень линии / Начать линию» and one caption, «Улучшается до» and «Получается из» as on the item page, the set bonus under the set, «Карты правил, до 3».
Error and focus: a failed save. The summary takes the focus (gold ring) and links each field; each field says its own message.
Longest name: a 120-character item name; the title takes one line at 360 and three at 1180, the Name field holds it in full.
Open: the crop dialog with corner handles, a thirds grid and a 24 px zoom thumb; the keyboard text stays for assistive tech only.
Conflict: another device saved first. The primary shows the new version; replacing it is the danger choice; «Сохранить» is off.
